remarks: Discover this great 2-family home in the convenient Glenbrook neighborhood. Spanning 3,034 sq. ft., this property presents endless potential for investors or those seeking multigenerational living.  The remodeled first-floor unit features a brand-new kitchen with stunning quartzite countertops, modern laminate flooring, and fresh paint throughout. With 3 spacious bedrooms, 2 baths, and a cozy living room complete with a fireplace, it's designed for comfort and style. The flexible formal dining room, accented by a bow window, can serve as a den or office to suit your needs.  The second-floor unit is appealing in space and size, offering a bright and open layout. It includes a living room with a fireplace, a family room, 3 bedrooms, and a full bath. Natural light pours through large windows, creating an inviting atmosphere. A generous walk-up attic has additional space-ideal for a gym, playroom, or extra storage. There is also a full, unfinished basement.  Each unit has its own furnace and hot water heater for convenience and efficiency. The private backyard is perfect for gardening, relaxation, or play, while 3 parking spaces and a 2-car garage add unparalleled practicality.  This property, being sold "as is," represents an incredible opportunity to own a versatile and spacious home. Rents are currently under market value and there is opportunity there! Don't wait-schedule your appointment today and unlock its potential!
